hero.subheadline: Clar Construction plans every detail of your kitchen or bath up front, then builds it at a fixed price. Cabinets come from its own millwork shop in Montpelier's old clothespin factory.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Montpelier VT area project in Stowe: walnut-stained island with gas range, ceiling-mounted stainless hood, white cabinets and open wood shelves

intro.h2: Why planning comes first at Clar
paragraphs: Clar Construction has offered kitchen remodeling in Montpelier, VT and the towns within a half hour since 2004. Dan Clar started the company as its only employee. Today it is a full team of carpenters working out of a shop on Granite Street. They build kitchens, baths, additions, decks and custom cabinetry.

The firm's motto on surprises is simple: 'You like surprises? We don't.' Before construction starts, you and the team settle everything from the floor plan down to the grout color and towel bars, so the price can be fixed. Google reviewers note that while others may charge less, the quality justifies the price.

services.h2: Built by Clar's carpenters and shop

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens planned around how you cook and gather, in modern, farmhouse, traditional or mixed styles. Everything is mapped out before a single tool is lifted. Cabinetry, counters and lighting plans come together with custom pieces from the shop when the design calls for them.

image.alt: Vermont farmhouse kitchen remodel with exposed timber beams and posts, wood stove, sage cabinets and painted island

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, three-quarter baths, half baths and brand-new bathrooms. Walk-in showers, glass doors, tiled floors, heated floors, an added window and more storage are all common requests. One Google reviewer had Clar renovate a 50-year-old bathroom after an earlier window job.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with soaking tub and beadboard apron, frameless glass shower, grab bars and slate-look tile floor

items.name: Custom Cabinetry and Built-Ins
items.blurb: In its 2,000 sq. ft. shop, Clar builds kitchen and bath cabinets, vanities with matching mirrors, bookcases, mudroom lockers, benches and closets. Built-ins are made to look like they were always there. One client's bookcase and under-stair drawers did just that.

image.alt: Custom built-in wood bookcases with a rolling library ladder, reading chair and window seat, made in Clar's Montpelier shop

items.name: Additions and Sunrooms
items.blurb: Add a room instead of moving. Clar designs and builds additions, mudrooms and sunrooms lined with airtight, energy-efficient windows that bring in light all year. The same team handles decks and porches made for a Vermont summer.

image.alt: Sunroom addition with a wall of windows, wood ceiling, stained concrete floor and dining table

items.name: Whole-Home, Historic and Aging-in-Place Work
items.blurb: Clar began in 2004 with a focus on preserving Vermont's historic buildings, and still takes on full remodels of older homes. Many clients also plan changes that help them stay in their homes through retirement, from safer baths to better layouts.

image.alt: Whole-home remodel of an older house with arched doorway, shiplap walls, raised reading nook and wood floors

why_choose_us.h2: Is Clar the right fit for you?

items.title: A fixed price you can trust
items.text: Every detail is chosen during the Project Development phase, so the contract is a fixed price. If you change goals along the way, the cost of that change is discussed openly first.

items.title: A lead carpenter you already know
items.text: One of Clar's lead carpenters, someone you meet during planning, runs your job. He or she coordinates the licensed electricians, plumbers and roofers and sends periodic updates.

items.title: Honest about fit
items.text: Clar says it is not for homeowners chasing the cheapest bid or needing work to start tomorrow. It suits people who care more about doing it right than doing it fast.

items.title: Pricing alternatives offered
items.text: One longtime client wrote that you always know where you stand expense-wise and are given pricing alternatives. Projects typically range from $25,000 to more than $1 million.

about.h2: Dan Clar, from steeples to kitchens
about.text: Dan Clar grew up in Rochester, NY and earned a degree in Education. In college he worked for a contractor that restored church steeples. He spent half his time in the millwork shop making parts and the other half hanging 125 feet up in a bosun's chair to install them. That job hooked him on carpentry. In 2004 he started Clar Construction in Montpelier as its only employee. The company now works from the historic National Clothespin Company building on Granite Street, turned into a millwork shop. Dan lives in Montpelier with his family and is trying to figure out how to build a wooden canoe.

image.alt: Dan Clar, owner of Clar Construction in Montpelier, VT

process.h2: Four steps from first talk to warranty

steps.title: Get to know each other
steps.text: Call, email or walk into the office. Clar learns your ideas, explains its design-build process and suggests a price range based on similar past projects.

steps.title: Project Development Agreement
steps.text: Through a series of meetings with in-house staff or partner designers, you settle every detail, from the floor plan to the towel bars.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Your lead carpenter runs the schedule with insured trade partners and keeps you posted on which trades are coming in the weeks ahead.

steps.title: Completion and warranty
steps.text: Near the end, you meet to list any open items, so they get finished while the crew and tools are still at your house.

service_area.h2: Within a half hour of Montpelier
service_area.text: Clar works mostly within a half-hour radius of Montpelier, where its shop and office sit downtown on Granite Street. Recent clients include a Stowe kitchen and repeat customers who came back after window and siding work. The towns it names include Barre, Berlin, Northfield, Middlesex, Worcester, Calais, Marshfield, Plainfield, Duxbury, Waterbury and Stowe. Have a larger project farther out? Ask, because the team sometimes takes on work beyond this area.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Montpelier, VT: common questions

items.q: What does a kitchen or bath remodel with Clar cost?
items.a: Clar's clients typically invest between $25,000 and $1 million or more, depending on size and scope. At the first meeting, the team compares your budget with similar projects it has finished and suggests a price range. For complex projects, it sets a second meeting within a week to review that range.

Yes. Clar offers a free consultation with no sales pressure. You can call, email or walk into the Granite Street office. The team will ask about your current thinking, may suggest ideas you had not considered, and will explain how its design-build process works so you can decide if it suits you.

items.q: What is the Project Development Agreement?
items.a: It is the planning agreement you sign after the first meeting, once you agree on a target budget. In a series of meetings with Clar's in-house staff or partner designers and architects, you settle every detail of the project. That level of detail is what lets Clar offer a fixed price in the construction agreement.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Clar's own carpenters, led by one of its lead carpenters, whom you will already have met during planning. Licensed trades such as electricians, plumbers and roofers come from trade partners, and everyone on your project is properly insured. Planning also covers dust control, snow clearing and any needs of children or pets.

items.q: Can you build cabinets for my kitchen or bath?
items.a: Yes. In its 2,000 sq. ft. shop in the old National Clothespin Company building, Clar builds kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities with matching mirrors, bookshelves, mudroom lockers, benches, closets, custom doors and built-in seating. The shop also does custom trim details when a project needs them, for homeowners and for other contractors.

final_cta.h2: Start with a conversation on Granite Street
final_cta.text: Call the office or book a free consultation to talk through your kitchen, bath or addition with Dan's team.
